title: DTC 51 ABS Pump Motor Lock
ocr_text:
BR–97
BRAKE SYSTEM – ANTI–LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS)

DTC 51 ABS Pump Motor Lock
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

DTC No. | Diagnostic Trouble Code Detecting Condition | Trouble area
51 | Pump motor is not operating normally during initial check. | ABS pump motor

Fail safe function: If trouble occurs in the ABS pump motor, the ECU cuts off the current to the solenoid relay and prohibits ABS control.

WIRING DIAGRAM

See page BR–72

INSPECTION PROCEDURE
See inspection of ABS actuator (See page BR–44).
